runs.t: A case in point is our advisory role on the Accelerated Bookbuild (ABB) for StonePine Ace Partners’ sale of its 7% stake in Taaleem Management Services (TALM.CA), the leading higher education platform in Egypt, marking the fund’s successful exit from the company. EFG Hermes acted as the sole financial advisor and sole bookrunner on the transaction.
The deal underscores EFG Hermes’ ability to deliver swift monetization options and reflects the sustained investor interest in the country’s education sector.
